subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II evidence window and redaction guidance
messages:
From: Lauren Mills <l.mills@brightaudit.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2028-07-11 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II evidence window + redaction/transport guidance

Hi Priyom / Laura,

Quick ask from our end as we start scoping Acme's SOC 2 Type II intake: can you confirm the audit period (we currently have Feb 1 2027 - Jan 31 2028 listed) and provide a short inventory of artifacts you can share (policy snapshots, config exports, auth logs, change control records, CS/incident reports).

Two items we repeatedly see questions on:
- Redaction: are you able to provide system logs with IP truncation/pseudonymization, or do you need us to accept heavily redacted PDFs?
- Transport: do you prefer S3 presigned links, secure shareDrive, or an SFTP drop? We also support an encrypted auditor portal if needed.

If you can send a one-page bridge letter that states the audit window and any excluded controls, that will speed acceptance. Also attach any NDA or procurement constraints we should know.

Target: intake bundle within 7 business days if possible; otherwise propose a short timeline and who will be the intake lead.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Mills
Senior Manager, BrightAudit LLC
l.mills@brightaudit.com
+1 415 555 0124

Attachment: auditor_checklist_v2.pdf (stated, not attached here)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Mills <l.mills@brightaudit.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-11 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II evidence window + redaction/transport guidance

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear ask. Quick ack and proposed plan below.

1) Audit period: confirmed for Feb 1 2027 – Jan 31 2028 (we'll include a bridge letter that repeats this and notes no control exclusions).

2) Inventory: we will prepare a compact CSV manifest with artifacts by control family (policies, IAM snapshots, config exports, auth and admin audit logs, change control tickets, incident reports). We will label items as: full, redacted, or sample. Expect ~45 artefacts in the initial bundle.

3) Redaction: Redwood can provide logs with IP truncation (last octet masked) and user IDs pseudonymized. For items where redaction would defeat the audit (e.g., admin escalation trails) we'll supply sanitized extracts and supporting attestation. If BrightAudit requires verbatim logs for specific tests, please flag which controls so we can plan redaction exception approvals.

4) Transport: preferred path is S3 presigned upload to a scoped bucket (we'll provide credentials and single-use URLs). If you require portal delivery, we can use BrightAudit's portal too — whichever reduces turnaround.

5) Timeline: initial manifest & bridge-letter draft by end of day Jul 12; secure bundle delivery (presigned links) by Jul 18. If that works we'll keep Laura as intake lead and loop Dev for large telemetry extracts.

I've attached a short bridge letter draft and an evidence_inventory.csv (stubs). Also including a sample telemetry snippet and our recommended quick-reply templates for internal delegations.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Head of Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachments: bridge_letter_draft.pdf, evidence_inventory.csv, sample_telemetry_snippet.json, intake_quick_replies.txt

From: Lauren Mills <l.mills@brightaudit.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2028-07-11 14:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II evidence window + redaction/transport guidance

Thanks Priyom — helpful. Couple clarifications:

- Redaction policy: BrightAudit can accept pseudonymized identifiers and truncated IPs for operational logs. For admin-authentication sequences used in change control testing, we will need a non-redacted chain-of-custody for a sampling of events (we'll limit to 3-5 instances).

- Telemetry: for throughput/latency telemetry, a 48-hour sample (anonymized) is usually enough. Please include the time zone of timestamps.

- NDA/procurement: Acme Procurement prefers a short MSA addendum before we accept presigned uploads — procurement@acmecorp.com is on this thread. If you can provide a statement that Redwood will not retain copies beyond the audit window and will encrypt objects at rest, that satisfies their check.

No change to timeline from our side — Jul 18 delivery is okay.

Lauren

On the logistics: portal link for evidence is https://brightaudit.com/portal/requests/ACME-224 — we can create a workspace if you prefer to avoid S3 exchanges.

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Mills <l.mills@brightaudit.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-12 08:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II evidence window + redaction/transport guidance

Lauren / team — following up with the concrete intake package plan.

What we'll share (initial bundle):
- Bridge letter (attached) that states audit window and confirms no excluded controls.
- Policies: Access control, Change management, Incident response (latest snapshots dated Jan 2028).
- Config exports: IAM role list, KMS policy snapshot.
- Auth logs: 90-day admin activity extract (pseudonymized, IP masked) + 5 full chain-of-custody samples for admin escalations (per your request).
- Change control: JIRA exports for change tickets (sample of 10 that span the audit window).
- Incident reports: 3 redacted post-incident reviews with attachments.
- Telemetry: 48-hour anonymized sample with timezone (UTC).

Transport and retention: we'll upload to our scoped S3 presigned path (s3://redwood-evidence-presigned/2028-07/acme-package/) by Jul 18 and will set object lifecycle to auto-delete after 90 days. All objects encrypted at rest (SSE-KMS) — I will attach the scoped retention statement for procurement.

Bridge letter draft (attached) is intentionally short. Please confirm if you want any additional control-level disclaimers.

Intake leads: Laura Bennett (primary) and Dev Patel (telemetry/exports). Neha will coordinate redaction approvals if BrightAudit requests deeper logs.

Attached: bridge_letter_draft.pdf, evidence_inventory.csv, intake_quick_replies.txt, sample_telemetry_snippet.json

Next steps: Laura will confirm bucket details and send presigned upload instructions. If Acme procurement needs a signed addendum, send a redline to procurement@acmecorp.com and we'll accelerate.

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Lauren Mills <l.mills@brightaudit.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2028-07-12 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II evidence window + redaction/transport guidance

Perfect — that plan works for us.

Confirmed: BrightAudit accepts the 5 chain-of-custody samples as non-redacted for control testing. Portal or S3 is fine; we'll take S3 presigned uploads.

Procurement: Acme — Redwood's retention/auto-delete + SSE-KMS statement should suffice; please confirm if you need an addendum.

I'll create the BrightAudit workspace and invite Laura and Priyom so we can track files. Expect a workspace invite in the next hour. We'll aim to start tests the week of Jul 22.

Thanks all,
Lauren

--
